the black Kantemo,

emerge, let it cry out from its mouth, its bite.

The four who divide the earth, let it be gathered.

Thus speaks Ah Mo Balam, who stands before them:
"Go down, speak your word!
Four are the gods, four are the people,
Two by means of the witch women,
Who is it that blocks the flea's hole?
You also, four gods,
You also, four people — the flea
In its white place, in its opening, through its passage,
Through its hole it makes the sound of nooke, so it is,
Enter through the hole, a little, gently,
So it is, enter through the hole,
A little, go, virgin girl,
Enter through the navel, a little, tiny one,
So, go a little, virgin."

its face going in spiraling,

Again the cha cauix stirs it into pain,
speaking these words, which are also the words
of our Father God himself.

so then, chu chu, the one who strikes,

going by day, Hun Ahau,
